entries.name: Clipchamp
entries.description: Provides a user-friendly video editor with built-in templates, effects, and timeline editing tools.

entries.name: Microsoft Teams
entries.description: Facilitates instant messaging, video conferencing, file sharing, and workspace collaboration.

entries.name: News
entries.description: Aggregates breaking news headlines, personalized article feeds, and world current events.

entries.name: Bing Search
entries.description: Integrates Microsoft Bing search capabilities and web services directly into the operating system.

entries.name: Weather
entries.description: Displays local real-time weather tracking, radar maps, and historical meteorological forecasts.

entries.name: Copilot
entries.description: Launches the Microsoft AI companion for contextual answers, creative writing assistance, and intelligent web search.

entries.name: Xbox App
entries.description: Serves as the primary gaming library manager, social community interface, and PC Game Pass dashboard.

entries.name: Get Help
entries.description: Provides access to automated troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and direct Microsoft customer assistance.

entries.name: Microsoft 365
entries.description: Serves as a centralized launcher and dashboard for accessing cloud-based Microsoft 365 apps and recent documents.

entries.name: Solitaire Collection
entries.description: Bundles built-in card game modes including Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, and TriPeaks alongside daily challenges.

entries.name: Sticky Notes
entries.description: Creates quick, floating text notes on the desktop that automatically sync across devices.

entries.name: Outlook for Windows
entries.description: Provides modern email management, calendar scheduling, and contact organization features.

entries.name: Paint
entries.description: Provides built-in digital sketching, basic image editing, and pixel-level graphic manipulation tools.

entries.name: Power Automate
entries.description: Automates repetitive workflows and desktop tasks using low-code visual scripting.

entries.name: Snipping Tool
entries.description: Captures screenshots or screen recordings with built-in markup, image cropping, and optical character recognition (OCR).

entries.name: Start Experiences App
entries.description: Powers the Windows Widgets board, delivering a personalized feed of news, weather, sports, and finance content.

entries.name: To Do
entries.description: Creates, tracks, and synchronizes personal tasks, smart lists, and daily reminders.

entries.name: Dev Home
entries.description: Provides a specialized dashboard for software developer environment setups, repository syncing, and hardware widgets.

entries.name: Photos
entries.description: Organizes, views, and crops local images with basic color adjustment and album creation tools.

entries.name: Clock
entries.description: Features world clocks, alarms, countdown timers, stopwatches, and dedicated focus session tracking.

entries.name: Calculator
entries.description: Performs standard arithmetic, scientific operations, programming calculations, and unit conversions.

entries.name: Camera
entries.description: Captures photographs and records video files via connected webcams or imaging hardware.

entries.name: Feedback Hub
entries.description: Allows users to submit bug reports, feature suggestions, and diagnostic data directly to Microsoft.

entries.name: Notepad
entries.description: Provides a lightweight text editor with multi-tab support for plain text files and code snippets.

entries.name: Sound Recorder
entries.description: Records and trims live audio inputs with simple microphone adjustment controls.

entries.name: Xbox TCUI
entries.description: Provides core account connection UI modules for single sign-on flows within game titles. Warning: removing this may break Microsoft account authentication in games and apps that do not otherwise require the Xbox app.

entries.name: Xbox Game Bar
entries.description: Provides customizable in-game status widgets, audio balancing sliders, system monitoring tools, and gameplay recording.

entries.name: Xbox Identity Provider
entries.description: Manages Xbox network user authentication and background account validation for connected titles. Warning: removing this may break Microsoft account sign-in for non-Xbox games and apps that rely on this authentication pipeline.

entries.name: Xbox Speech To Text Overlay
entries.description: Provides system-level live accessibility captions and voice-to-text translation for gaming chat networks.

entries.name: Phone Link
entries.description: Synchronizes text messages, phone notifications, photos, and calls from a mobile device to the desktop.

entries.name: Media Player
entries.description: Plays local audio and video files with modern playlist management and casting capabilities.

entries.name: Quick Assist
entries.description: Enables secure remote technical support and screen sharing over an internet connection.
